note: Demo image sets for local DB load-testing and future onboarding. OBJECTS ONLY — no people, animals, landscapes, or body parts. Every image was hand-picked from an explicit source and visually verified. Sources: Openverse (Flickr, CC-BY / CC-BY-SA) and Wikimedia Commons (CC0 museum catalog photos + a few CC-BY-SA studio shots). Attribution recorded per image (required for BY / BY-SA). Regenerate with: node scripts/fetch-demo-images.mjs
